h1: Custom Screen Print Outerwear for Teams
metaTitle: Custom Screen Print Outerwear | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom screen print outerwear for your team. Durable decoration on jackets, hoodies & more. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Screen printing is a go-to decoration method for bulk outerwear orders because it delivers bold, long-lasting graphics at a lower per-unit cost than embroidery. Whether you need company logos on employee hoodies or event branding on lightweight jackets, screen print outerwear holds up to frequent washing and outdoor wear. This finish works best on cotton or cotton-blend fabrics, making it ideal for fleece pullovers, zip-ups, and classic crewnecks. For large quantities, screen printing keeps your budget in check while keeping your team looking sharp.
